items.text: Steel: two diagonal lines (decided). Key steel is solid today; the change is planned as P-01.
Concrete. Key: concrete (stipple dots). Reference also shows small triangles; the key draws dots only.
Sand / cement. Key: screen (light dots), nearest match. The key is much denser than the reference, which is sparse.
Block, diagonal crosshatch. No key yet, so the swatch is left empty until batch 1 adds one.
Brick, diagonal (B-01 today, runs down to the right). Reference runs up to the right; see review sheet B-02.
Brick, running bond. Key: cmu, which is concrete block in running bond. Brick needs its own key.
Timber. Key: wood1 (lines along the grain). The reference shows vertical boards with breaks; no timber key yet.
Draft: verify before use. Keys are the nearest matches; see docs/lessons-learned_hatch.md.
